purpose: Keep the existing memory-core recall worker pool and idle SQLite handles warm for 12 h instead of the WorkerTaskPool 60 s default and the 30 min handle window, so a spoken turn after a pause neither respawns the recall worker nor reopens the agent database (whose reopen queues an integrity quick_check ahead of the session write) on the critical path; the pool's own memory-critical retirement is unchanged. A per-turn session participant record also stops opening a one-shot SQLite Worker while it holds the agent write admission: it uses OpenClaw's own native participant writer (the incognito path), so the session writes of the same turn no longer queue behind a Worker spawn.
